text:
Sofia: Heads-up: enterprise security team emailed with CAIQ follow-ups for the POC. They want crisp single-sentence responses and a shared responsibility row for keys/backups/logs. Can we sync?
Ravi: On it. Quick clarification: this customer is evaluating Hosted API for dev, Dedicated for prod. Private only if required. That affects who owns what.
Sofia: Exactly. Keep answers short. Ill compile into their CAIQ spreadsheet.
Morgan: High-level: Hosted - Redwood-managed keys/backups/logs; Dedicated - can be either depending on contract/BYOK; Private - customer-managed.
Ken: For CAIQ wording: emphasize BYOK availability for Dedicated/Private and that backup snapshots use customer KMS when BYOK enabled.
Ravi: Draft 1-line statements: 
- Keys: Hosted  Redwood-managed by default; Dedicated/Private support BYOK (customer-managed keys) per contract.
- Backups: Hosted/Dedicated  Redwood manages encrypted snapshots and retention; Private  customer-managed unless we provide managed services.
- Logs: Platform operational logs retained by Redwood (default 30 days, enterprise options 90/365); application logs in Private are customer-controlled.
Sofia: Add explicit "snapshots encrypted with customer KMS when BYOK is used" line.
Morgan: Added.
Ken: Also say we do not store plaintext keys.
Ravi: Final one-liners: 
"Keys: Hosted - Redwood-managed by default; Dedicated/Private support BYOK (customer-managed keys) per contract; Redwood does not retain plaintext customer keys."
"Backups: Hosted/Dedicated - Redwood manages encrypted snapshots with configurable retention; when BYOK is enabled snapshots are encrypted with the customer's KMS; Private - customer-managed unless managed-services contract."
"Logs: Redwood retains platform operational logs for 30 days by default (enterprise options 90/365); customer application logs in Private are controlled by the customer."
Sofia: Good. Now the shared responsibility row (one line):
Ravi: "Key Mgmt: Hosted - Redwood; Dedicated - Redwood or Customer (BYOK); Private - Customer."
"Backups: Hosted/Dedicated - Redwood; Private - Customer."
"Logs: Platform logs - Redwood; App logs - Customer."
Ken: Nice. I'll post into the CAIQ sheet and follow up with legal on BYOK contract language.
DeployBot: CAIQ entry created: https://redwood.internal/docs/caiq-drafts/1776004328-r2 (editable) :white_check_mark:
Sofia: Thanks team, passing to sales to re-share with the customer.
Ravi: Ping me if they ask for retention SLAs or deletion timing.
